# domicile.wiki

> The open guide to moving abroad: taxes, residence, daily life, with sources. An open, source-linked guide for wealthy families, expat employees and remote workers: tax on capital gains, dividends, wealth, inheritance and income; residence and citizenship routes per passport; succession law; cost of living; safety, stability and other daily-life indicators. Free; data CC BY-SA 4.0.

Each place has a text page (HTML) and a Markdown twin at the same address plus `index.md`. Figures are for the guide's default reader (an EU-citizen family of five with EUR 30M) unless stated. Every figure is dated and sourced; please cite the place page.

## Main pages

- [All places](https://domicile.wiki/places/): every researched country and region
- [Interactive guide](https://domicile.wiki/): rankings, comparisons and calculators for any passport and situation (JavaScript app)
- [Source code and method](https://github.com/davidszp/domicile-wiki): data pipeline, scoring model and research guides
- [All scores (JSON)](https://domicile.wiki/data/scores.json): per-place scores and key figures
